info.title: M365 Copilot
info.description: Access Microsoft 365 Copilot interaction data, meeting insights, transcripts, and recordings through official Microsoft Graph APIs. Requires Microsoft 365 Copilot license and appropriate permissions.

get.description: Gets the current authenticated user information for testing connection.

id.description: The unique identifier for the user.

displayName.description: The display name of the user.

userPrincipalName.description: The user principal name of the user.

post.description: Retrieves relevant text extracts from SharePoint, OneDrive, or Copilot connectors content that the calling user has access to, while respecting defined access controls within the tenant.

queryString.description: Natural language query string used to retrieve relevant text extracts (max 1,500 characters).

dataSource.description: Indicates whether extracts should be retrieved from SharePoint, OneDrive, or Copilot connectors.

dataSourceConfiguration.description: Additional configuration information for applicable data sources.

connectionId.description: The unique identifier of the Copilot connector connection.

filterExpression.description: KQL expression with queryable properties and attributes to scope the retrieval before the query runs

resourceMetadata.description: List of metadata fields to be returned for each item in the response.

maximumNumberOfResults.description: Number of results to return (between 1 and 25).

get.description: Gets all Microsoft 365 Copilot interaction data for a specific user, including user prompts to Copilot and Copilot responses across Microsoft 365 apps such as Teams, Word, and Outlook.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the user whose Copilot interactions to retrieve.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: Filter interactions by application class (e.g., appClass eq 'IPM.SkypeTeams.Message.Copilot.Teams' or appClass eq 'IPM.SkypeTeams.Message.Copilot.BizChat').

parameters.name: $top
parameters.description: The number of items to return (recommended value is 100 for optimal performance).

value.description: Array of detailed AI interaction objects with comprehensive interaction data.

get.summary: Get Copilot admin limited mode settings (Preview)
get.x-ms-summary: Get Copilot Admin Limited Mode Settings (Preview)
get.description: Gets the current settings that control whether users of Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams meetings can receive responses to sentiment-related prompts.

patch.summary: Update Copilot admin limited mode settings (Preview)
patch.x-ms-summary: Update Copilot Admin Limited Mode Settings (Preview)
patch.description: Updates the settings that control whether users of Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams meetings can receive responses to sentiment-related prompts.

isEnabledForGroup.description: Enables users to be in limited mode for Copilot in Teams meetings. When true, users in this mode can ask any questions, but Copilot doesn't respond to certain questions related to inferring emotions, behavior, or judgments. When false, it responds to all types of questions grounded to the meeting conversation.

groupId.description: The ID of a Microsoft Entra group for which the isEnabledForGroup value is applied. Required if isEnabledForGroup is set to true.

post.description: Creates a subscription to receive change notifications for Copilot AI interactions.

changeType.description: Comma-separated list of event types to monitor (e.g., 'created,updated,deleted').

notificationUrl.description: The URL of the endpoint that receives the change notifications.

resource.description: The resource path to monitor for changes (e.g., '/copilot/users/{userId}/interactionHistory/getAllEnterpriseInteractions' or '/copilot/interactionHistory/getAllEnterpriseInteractions').

expirationDateTime.description: The date and time when the subscription expires (maximum 1 hour from creation).

includeResourceData.description: Whether to include the changed resource data in notifications (requires encryption certificate).

encryptionCertificate.description: Base64-encoded public certificate for encrypting resource data (required if includeResourceData is true).

encryptionCertificateId.description: Custom identifier for the encryption certificate.

clientState.description: Secret client state that is returned with each notification.

lifecycleNotificationUrl.description: The URL for lifecycle notifications (required for subscriptions longer than 1 hour).

get.description: Lists all active subscriptions for Copilot change notifications.

parameters.name: $filter
parameters.description: Filter subscriptions by criteria (e.g., "resource eq '/copilot/interactionHistory/getAllEnterpriseInteractions'").

get.description: Gets details of a specific Copilot change notification subscription.

parameters.name: subscriptionId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the subscription.

patch.description: Updates an existing Copilot change notification subscription (typically to extend expiration).

parameters.name: subscriptionId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the subscription to update.

expirationDateTime.description: The new expiration date and time for the subscription.

delete.description: Deletes a Copilot change notification subscription.

parameters.name: subscriptionId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the subscription to delete.

RetrievalResponse.description: Response from the retrieval API containing relevant text extracts.

retrievalHits.description: Array of retrieval hits containing text extracts and metadata.

Subscription.description: Represents a subscription to change notifications.

changeType.description: Comma-separated list of event types being monitored.

notificationUrl.description: The URL where notifications are sent.

resource.description: The resource path being monitored for changes.

clientState.description: Optional client state returned with notifications.

latestSupportedTlsVersion.description: The latest version of TLS supported by the notification endpoint.

encryptionCertificate.description: Base64-encoded public certificate for encrypting resource data.

encryptionCertificateId.description: Custom identifier for the encryption certificate.

includeResourceData.description: Whether the changed resource data is included in notifications.

lifecycleNotificationUrl.description: The URL for receiving lifecycle notifications.

applicationId.description: Identifier of the application that created the subscription.

creatorId.description: Identifier of the user or service principal that created the subscription.

CopilotAdminLimitedMode.description: Represents settings that control whether users of Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams meetings can receive responses to sentiment-related prompts.

@odata.type.description: The OData type of the resource.

groupId.description: The ID of a Microsoft Entra group, for which the value of isEnabledForGroup is applied. The default value is null. If isEnabledForGroup is set to true, the groupId value must be provided for the Copilot limited mode in Teams meetings to be enabled for the members of the group.

isEnabledForGroup.description: Enables the user to be in limited mode for Copilot in Teams meetings. When copilotAdminLimitedMode=true, users in this mode can ask any questions, but Copilot doesn't respond to certain questions related to inferring emotions, behavior, or judgments. When copilotAdminLimitedMode=false, it responds to all types of questions grounded to the meeting conversation. The default value is false.

AIInteraction.description: Represents a comprehensive Microsoft 365 Copilot interaction with detailed data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AI interaction.

requestId.description: Unique identifier for the specific request.

appClass.description: The Microsoft 365 application where the interaction occurred (e.g., 'IPM.SkypeTeams.Message.Copilot.Teams', 'IPM.SkypeTeams.Message.Copilot.BizChat').

etag.description: Entity tag for versioning and caching.

contexts.description: Array of context objects providing additional information about the interaction environment.

links.description: Array of link objects referenced in the interaction.

InteractionContext.description: Context information about the interaction environment.

contextReference.description: URL or reference to the context source.

ChatMessageFromIdentitySet.description: Identity information about who sent the message.

displayName.description: Display name of the application (e.g., 'Copilot in Teams', 'Microsoft 365 Chat').

ItemBody.description: Body content of the interaction message.

content.description: The actual content of the message.

ChatMessageAttachment.description: Attachment associated with the chat message.

contentType.description: The content type of the attachment.

contentUrl.description: URL to access the attachment content.

RetrievalHit.description: A single retrieval hit containing text extracts and metadata.

webUrl.description: URL to access the source document.

extracts.description: Relevant text extracts from the document.

TextExtract.description: A text extract from a document.

sensitivityLabelId.description: Unique identifier for the sensitivity label.

displayName.description: Display name of the sensitivity label.

toolTip.description: Tooltip text for the sensitivity label.

priority.description: Priority level of the sensitivity label.

color.description: Color code for the sensitivity label.

CopilotInteraction.description: Represents a user interaction with Microsoft 365 Copilot.

userId.description: The user who initiated the interaction.

appClass.description: The Microsoft 365 application where the interaction occurred.

interactionType.description: The type of interaction (e.g., query, generation).

prompt.description: The user's input prompt to Copilot.

OnlineMeeting.description: Represents a Microsoft Teams online meeting.

AIInsight.description: Represents AI-generated insight metadata from a meeting.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AI insight

DetailedAIInsight.description: Detailed AI-generated insights from a meeting.

id.description: Unique identifier for the AI insight

actionItems.description: Action items extracted from the meeting.

MeetingNote.description: A note from the meeting discussion.

MeetingNoteSubpoint.description: A subpoint within a meeting note.

ActionItem.description: An action item identified from the meeting.

title.description: The title of the action item.

text.description: The description of the action item.

ownerDisplayName.description: The display name of the person assigned the action item.

MentionEvent.description: An event where a participant was mentioned.

meetingId.description: The meeting this transcript belongs to.

transcriptContentUrl.description: URL to access the transcript content.

meetingId.description: The meeting this recording belongs to.

recordingContentUrl.description: URL to access the recording content.
